subject: Request: HealthSync case study discovery — 20-minute interview & recording?

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: HealthSync case study discovery — 20-minute interview & recording?

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for agreeing to help with a customer spot. We’d love to record a short discovery interview to capture the product impact and a couple of quotes for a case study — 20 minutes should be plenty. Proposed agenda below; attach the one-pager (case-study-agenda.pdf) for your review.

Proposed agenda (20 min)
- Quick intros and roles (2 min)
- High-level context on why HealthSync evaluated Redwood (3 min)
- Concrete outcomes & metrics (8 min)
- Customer quote / soundbite (3 min)
- Next steps & post-call approvals (4 min)

We have the following windows available this week (PT):
- Wed 11/25, 10:00–10:30
- Thu 11/26, 13:00–13:30
- Fri 11/27, 15:00–15:30

If recording is fine, we’ll capture audio only, share the clip for your legal approval, and provide a short release to sign. I’ve attached a sample release form and included a DocuSign link below for convenience.

Can you confirm which slot works and whether Legal should be on the invite? If there are folks from CS or Product you'd like included, tell me and I’ll add them.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234
DocuSign (release): https://www.docusign.net/signed/ABCDEF123456

Thanks,

Sofia Ivanova
Customer Marketing Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachments: case-study-agenda.pdf (PDF), release-form.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — we can do 11/25 at 10:00 PT. I’ve looped in Alex from Legal (cc’d) to confirm the release process — he’ll need to review the release text and confirm signing. Also looping in our marketing lead in case they want to approve any quotes.

- Elena Morales (Head of Product, HealthSync)

Elena
